title: Jimmy Noone, Freddie Keppard and Joe Oliver
summary: Allen asks about Noone, Keppard and Oliver; he does not remember much.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: One other man I was going to ask you about, he was more of a boy in your time, Jimmy Noon. Do you remember? Jimmy Noon.
They called him some? Jimmy Noon. He played more when he got to Chicago on clarinet. Do you remember him playing clarinet here?
Jimmy Noon. That name sounds familiar, but I just can't place it. Jimmy Noon.
He was a friend of Freddie Keppard's and all.
Yeah, I know Freddie Keppard's. Yeah.
Yeah. Did you ever play with Joe Oliver?
Well, I believe I played, he played one dance with who? No, I never played with him, but I had a chance to- You haven't heard of him, didn't he?
